statement:
∀ (N : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
  1 - ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc (-↑N) ↑N, (-1) ^ n * Complex.exp (↑n * ↑x * Complex.I) =
    ↑(2 * ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, (-1) ^ (n + 2) * cos ((↑n + 1) * x))

goal.text:
1 - ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc (-↑N) ↑N, (-1) ^ n * Complex.exp (↑n * ↑x * Complex.I) =
  ↑(2 * ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, (-1) ^ (n + 2) * cos ((↑n + 1) * x))
